summary: TC Energy furnished a Form 6-K news release dated September 29, 2026, announcing Coastal GasLink Phase 2 will proceed after LNG Canada and its joint venture participants reached a positive Final Investment Decision on the LNG Canada expansion, satisfying conditions tied to TC Energy's prior conditional FID. Phase 2 nearly doubles existing capacity of the 670-kilometre pipeline from Dawson Creek to Kitimat, adding compressor stations and facility upgrades above current roughly 2.1 Bcf/d throughput. LNG Canada serves as Phase 2 Execution Manager; CGL remains owner, operator and permit holder, with capped construction cost and schedule exposure. Peak construction employment is estimated at up to 2,100 across five sites.
